headline: Reuters sources say the 13 Oct strike on Aramco's Dhahran headquarters caused extensive damage across floors six to ten, with staff moved to remote work and some functions shifted to global offices. The AI-infrastructure trade cracked on the same day: Gartner warned over $3.5T of AI-infrastructure spend could be impaired by 2030, CoreWeave bonds turned distressed and Barclays downgraded Dell, HPE and NetApp, then the Kospi fell 7.6%. In the Gulf, Meeza and Microsoft launched a sovereign private cloud on Azure Local in Qatar with no server OEM named, and MIS signed a SAR 179.8M IT contract with King Saud Medical City. Semafor reports PIF is preparing to drop five World Cup stadiums including NEOM, ROSHN and Qiddiya Coast.
lenovo_read: Buyers will now challenge AI-factory budgets and giga-project scope at once: sell right-sized, on-premises sovereign AI with clear economics and delivery certainty, and chase funded vehicles such as Meeza/Azure Local, MIS and the DGA framework agreements.

pillars.dc: 3 scored: Meeza–Microsoft sovereign private cloud (Qatar), 3C Datalec Gulf push, Nvidia says Gulf AI plans unchanged. No KSA/GCC DC build, MW figure or PPA first published in window; Gartner impairment warning is the sizing signal.
pillars.memory: 6 scored: IDC smartphones -22%, TSMC Q3 record, Kospi -7.6%, retail DDR5 $449.97, SK hynix US-fab condition, Samsung 4F². DRAMeXchange DDR5 16Gb spot $60.433 (+0.55%) on 15 Oct; no new contract print.
pillars.deals: 4 scored: MIS–KSMC SAR 179.8M, Meeza–Microsoft, LG–Al Mulla Kuwait, Google Cloud–QIX. No KSA/GCC tech round of $20M or more; only OEM named is LG.
pillars.global: Microsoft (Qatar), Nvidia (Gulf), Google Cloud (Qatar), LG (Kuwait) scored. Global: Gartner impairment, Barclays downgrades Dell/HPE, CoreWeave rout, OpenAI engineer case. No verified Chinese-rule META item; Hisense item rejected as a repost.

stories.title: Saudi Aramco headquarters suffered extensive damage in Houthi attack, sources say
stories.summary: Reuters sources say fire from the 13 Oct attack spread across floors six to ten of Aramco's Dhahran HQ, with the top floors severely damaged. Operations continue but some staff work from home and some functions moved to global offices; the ministry still says limited fire.
bullets: Aramco's Dhahran HQ suffered extensive damage in an attack on Oct 13, with fire spreading across several floors, three people with direct knowledge told Reuters
A fire started on the ninth floor of the south wing and spread between the sixth and 10th floors; the top three floors, where CEO Amin Nasser's office is located, were severely damaged
Operations at the complex have continued normally, but some employees have been asked to work from home, and some functions have been shifted to global offices
stories.lenovo: Real IT-estate loss at Lenovo's largest KSA energy account: device replacement, remote-work kits and DR or secondary-site capacity outside the Eastern Province. Offer quietly via the account team; Dell is positioned at Aramco Digital.
stories.arabic: نقلت رويترز عن مصادر أن هجوم 13 أكتوبر ألحق أضراراً واسعة بمقر أرامكو في الظهران وامتد الحريق بين الطابقين السادس والعاشر، مع نقل بعض المهام وتوجيه موظفين للعمل عن بعد، بينما تصفه وزارة الطاقة بحريق محدود.

stories.title: Exclusive / Saudi set to drop plans for five 2034 World Cup stadiums
stories.summary: Semafor reports PIF is preparing to drop five planned stadiums at KAEC, Qiddiya Coast, ROSHN, New Murabba and NEOM, leaving 10 venues. The Aramco Dhahran, King Salman International and PMBS stadiums proceed; the decision is not final.
bullets: PIF is preparing to tell FIFA organizers it will drop five proposed new stadiums for the 2034 World Cup, leaving 10 stadiums for matches
The stadiums being dropped are in King Abdullah Economic City, Qiddiya Coast, Roshn, New Murabba and NEOM
Saudi Arabia is still proceeding with stadiums in Dhahran (developed by Saudi Aramco), King Salman International Stadium and Prince Mohammed bin Salman Stadium in Riyadh
stories.lenovo: De-risk smart-venue edge, command-centre and workforce-device pipelines tied to NEOM, ROSHN, Qiddiya Coast and New Murabba; redirect effort to King Salman International and the Aramco stadium.
stories.arabic: أفادت سيمافور بأن صندوق الاستثمارات العامة يستعد لإلغاء خطط خمسة ملاعب لكأس العالم 2034 بينها نيوم وروشن والقدية والمربع الجديد، مع الإبقاء على ملعب أرامكو وملعب الملك سلمان الدولي، والقرار لم يُحسم بعد.

stories.title: MIS signs SAR 179.8M contract with KSMC
stories.summary: Al Moammar Information Systems signed a 60-month, SAR 179.78M contract with King Saud Medical City for IT works and services and medical-device operation and maintenance. Financial impact runs from Q1 2027 to Q4 2031.
bullets: Al Moammar Information Systems Co. (MIS) signed a contract worth SAR 179.78 million, including VAT, with King Saud Medical City (KSMC)
The contract covers operation, maintenance and repair of medical devices and equipment, and includes providing IT work and services to KSMC
The contract runs for 60 months, with the financial impact expected from Q1 2027 through Q4 2031
stories.lenovo: Hardware OEM undisclosed: open IDG endpoint and ISG hospital DC opportunity through MIS, which is also HUMAIN's work-order contractor.
stories.arabic: وقّعت شركة المعمر لأنظمة المعلومات عقداً مع مدينة الملك سعود الطبية بقيمة 179.8 مليون ريال لمدة 60 شهراً يشمل أعمال وخدمات تقنية المعلومات وتشغيل وصيانة الأجهزة الطبية، دون الإفصاح عن مورد العتاد.

stories.title: Investment conference: Saudi Arabia offers alternative travel routes
stories.summary: AFP reports FII10 (26–29 Oct) will go ahead with on-site and virtual attendance, with delegates offered routes via Dhahran by private jet or via Manama or Doha and then by road, as Riyadh airport stays suspended.
bullets: Saudi Arabia plans to move ahead with the FII forum in Riyadh from October 26 to 29, offering on-site and virtual attendance plus alternative air and land routes, diplomatic sources told AFP
Arrangements discussed include flying by private jet to Dhahran airport, or travelling to Manama or Doha, then driving to Riyadh
Riyadh's international airport suspended operations after 13 were killed in a strike; a total of 18 people have been killed at the airport in attacks since October 7
stories.lenovo: Smaller, slower in-person FII audience: pre-book executive meetings, and cover Dhahran routing in delegation security planning.
stories.arabic: ذكرت وكالة فرانس برس أن منظمي مبادرة مستقبل الاستثمار يعرضون مسارات سفر بديلة عبر الظهران أو المنامة أو الدوحة ثم براً إلى الرياض، في ظل استمرار تعليق مطار الملك خالد الدولي.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia’s Cybersecurity Market Reaches SAR16.3 Billion, NCA Report Shows
stories.summary: NCA sizes the 2025 Saudi cybersecurity market at SAR 16.3bn (10.7% CAGR 2023–25), with government at SAR 5.1bn and private sector at SAR 11.2bn; products are SAR 8.3bn.
bullets: The Kingdom's cybersecurity market reached SAR16.3 billion in 2025, a CAGR of 10.7% between 2023 and 2025
Government spending was approximately SAR5.1 billion (31%) and private-sector spending reached SAR11.2 billion (69%)
The sector's contribution to GDP reached approximately SAR20 billion in 2025, and cybersecurity professionals exceeded 22,000, with women at 33%
stories.lenovo: Sizes the opportunity for ThinkShield secured endpoints (IDG) and immutable/cyber-recovery storage (ISG); supports OPP-070.
stories.arabic: أظهر تقرير الهيئة الوطنية للأمن السيبراني أن سوق الأمن السيبراني في المملكة بلغ 16.3 مليار ريال في 2025، بنمو سنوي 10.7%، وتشكل المنتجات 8.3 مليار ريال منه.

stories.title: Meeza, Microsoft launch Sovereign Private Cloud for enterprises in Qatar
stories.summary: Microsoft Sovereign Private Cloud launched in Qatar on Azure Local in Meeza's in-country data centres, with Meeza providing hardware, connectivity, deployment and managed services and a dedicated government-network path.
bullets: Meeza and Microsoft announced the Microsoft Sovereign Private Cloud for Qatari enterprises, built on Azure Local
Meeza provides the in-country data centre, hardware, connectivity, deployment, operations and managed services; customers can run selected regulated workloads on infrastructure inside Qatar
Government entities get a dedicated access route through Meeza's connection to the government network, without going over the public internet
stories.lenovo: Server OEM undisclosed and Azure Local runs only on validated hardware: open ISG opportunity for ThinkAgile MX, and a sovereign-cloud pattern to repeat in KSA and the UAE.
stories.arabic: أطلقت ميزة ومايكروسوفت السحابة الخاصة السيادية في قطر على منصة Azure Local داخل مراكز بيانات ميزة، التي تتولى توفير العتاد والتشغيل والخدمات المُدارة، دون الإفصاح عن مورد الخوادم.

stories.title: AI plans 'have not changed' in Middle East despite Iran conflict, Nvidia says
stories.summary: Nvidia's global policy lead Ruth Berry said Gulf AI infrastructure demand remains strong despite the Iran conflict; the UAE received first Nvidia shipments in May, and MEI analysts say conflict may raise Gulf compute spend.
bullets: Ruth Berry, who leads global policy on Nvidia's government affairs team, told the Middle East Institute that Gulf countries' AI imperatives "have not changed"
The UAE received its first shipments of Nvidia CPUs and GPUs in May, after giving security assurances against unauthorised access
Analyst Mohammed Soliman said the threat of conflict could push the UAE and Saudi Arabia to increase AI investment, and that the US and China are the main contenders for Middle East AI business
stories.lenovo: GPU supply side signals continuity for HUMAIN and G42 build-outs; keep ISG AI-factory pipeline in plan and add multi-site resilience to the pitch.
stories.arabic: قالت إنفيديا إن خطط الذكاء الاصطناعي في الشرق الأوسط لم تتغير رغم النزاع مع إيران، مؤكدة استمرار الطلب الخليجي على البنية التحتية، فيما يرى محللون أن النزاع قد يزيد الإنفاق على الحوسبة.

stories.title: MBZUAI's Institute of Foundation Models and Inception42 launch Jais 3: Arabic-native AI for speech, writing and agents
stories.summary: Jais 3 is a family of six open Arabic-native models from 900M to 375B parameters plus Jais Speech, built on K2 Horizon with Cerebras and a 512K-token context, released on Hugging Face.
bullets: Jais 3 comprises six open language models ranging from 900 million to 375 billion parameters, plus Jais Speech for Arabic and its dialects
It is built on IFM's K2 Horizon, developed with Cerebras Systems, and supports a 512,000-token context window
At 7 billion parameters, the average Arabic evaluation score rose from 56.4 (K2 Horizon base) to 79.6 (Jais 3); the models are available on Hugging Face
stories.lenovo: Open Arabic models up to 375B parameters drive on-premises sovereign inference demand (ISG GPU servers, IDG AI PCs); validate Jais 3 on ThinkSystem.
stories.arabic: أطلق معهد النماذج التأسيسية في جامعة محمد بن زايد وInception42 نموذج "جيس 3" العربي بست نماذج مفتوحة تصل إلى 375 مليار معامل وسياق 512 ألف رمز، بالتعاون مع Cerebras.

stories.title: LG Electronics Accelerates GCC Growth Trajectory with Strategic Partnership in Kuwait
stories.summary: Al Mulla Electronics becomes LG's authorised distributor in Kuwait for a lineup including laptops and monitors, displays, signage and HVAC, with an experience and service center planned for 2027.
bullets: LG Electronics signed a strategic distribution agreement with Al Mulla Group, making Al Mulla Electronics an authorised LG distributor in Kuwait
The lineup includes OLED and QNED displays, AI-enabled home appliances, laptops and monitors, digital signage, and commercial HVAC including VRF systems and chillers
An integrated facility with a flagship LG Experience Center and an after-sales service center is scheduled to launch in 2027
stories.lenovo: Direct IDG competitor move into Kuwait notebooks and monitors through a top distribution group; defend channel and shelf share.
stories.arabic: عيّنت إل جي إلكترونيكس شركة الملا للإلكترونيات موزعاً معتمداً في الكويت لمحفظة تشمل أجهزة الحاسوب المحمولة والشاشات والعروض التجارية والتكييف، مع خطط لمركز تجربة وخدمة في 2027.

stories.title: 3C Datalec targets Gulf AI data centre market following merger
stories.summary: UK liquid-cooling firm 3C merged with Datalec to form 3C Datalec, forecasting over $400M of 2026 revenue, with Dubai and Abu Dhabi offices, a Jebel Ali hub and a new Saudi entity.
bullets: 3C merged with London-based Datalec Precision Installations to form 3C Datalec, which forecasts 2026 revenue of over $400 million
The company operates in Dubai and Abu Dhabi, with a 51,000-square-foot Jebel Ali site, and is setting up a Saudi company incorporated in May 2026
It works with four of the five largest hyperscalers and over 25 colocation providers, with active projects in 16 countries
stories.lenovo: Cooling and M&E contractor, not an OEM: potential integration partner for Neptune liquid-cooled racks in GCC AI halls.
stories.arabic: تستهدف 3C Datalec سوق مراكز بيانات الذكاء الاصطناعي في الخليج بعد اندماجها، مع كيان سعودي جديد ومركز إقليمي في جبل علي وإيرادات متوقعة تتجاوز 400 مليون دولار في 2026.

stories.title: CRA announces onboarding of Google Cloud to QIX
stories.summary: Qatar's Communications Regulatory Authority added Google Cloud to the Qatar Internet Exchange to keep traffic local and cut latency.
bullets: The Communications Regulatory Authority announced Google Cloud has joined the Qatar Internet Exchange (QIX) as a new member
QIX members are expected to gain improved local access to Google Cloud services, reduced latency and better network performance
Ali Al-Suwaidi, CRA Director of Technical Affairs and Chair of the QIX Steering Committee, called it "an important step in the evolution of the Qatar Internet Exchange"
stories.lenovo: Deepens hyperscaler presence in Qatar alongside Microsoft–Meeza; supports hybrid-cloud positioning for Qatari enterprises.
stories.arabic: أعلنت هيئة تنظيم الاتصالات في قطر انضمام جوجل كلاود إلى نقطة قطر لتبادل الإنترنت لإبقاء حركة البيانات محلياً وخفض زمن الاستجابة.

stories.title: Gartner Says Over $3.5 Trillion of AI Infrastructure Spending Could Be Exposed to Impairment by the End of 2030
stories.summary: Gartner estimates nearly $1T of AI infrastructure spend in 2026 plus $6T over 2027–30, against no more than $3.6T of attributable AI revenue, and expects over 80% of neoclouds to lose independence by 2030.
bullets: AI providers are expected to spend nearly $1 trillion on AI infrastructure in 2026, plus an additional $6 trillion between 2027 and 2030
AI data center owners would need a cumulative $8.5 trillion in revenue through 2030, but attributable AI revenue is forecast at no more than $3.6 trillion
By 2030, over 80% of neocloud providers are predicted to cease independent operations; AI-optimized IaaS spending to grow from $66 billion in 2027 to $174 billion in 2030
stories.lenovo: Triggered the AI-hardware sell-off; META sovereign-AI boards will ask about payback. Lead with phased, right-sized AI factories and TruScale consumption.
stories.arabic: حذّرت غارتنر من أن أكثر من 3.5 تريليون دولار من الإنفاق على البنية التحتية للذكاء الاصطناعي قد تتعرض لانخفاض القيمة بحلول 2030، وأن أكثر من 80% من شركات السحابة الناشئة ستفقد استقلاليتها.

stories.title: Dell, HPE and NetApp Stocks Slump After Downgrades on Worries About AI Spending
stories.summary: Barclays cut Dell, HPE and NetApp to Equal Weight, saying memory-shortage pricing propped up revenue without a real AI inflection; Dell fell 11%, HPE 8% and NetApp 7%.
bullets: Barclays cut Dell, HPE and NetApp to "equal weight" from "overweight", citing concerns about enterprise AI spending growth
Dell led S&P 500 decliners with an 11% tumble, while HPE fell 8% and NetApp sank 7%
Barclays said memory-shortage-driven higher prices "propped up revenues" but they "don't see a meaningful AI inflection yet"
stories.lenovo: Main ISG rivals under equity pressure: expect sharper Dell/HPE pricing in Q4 META bids. Hold margin with delivery certainty and ALAT local content.
stories.arabic: خفّض باركليز تصنيف أسهم ديل وإتش بي إي ونت آب، فتراجع سهم ديل 11% وسط مخاوف من أن ارتفاع أسعار الذاكرة دعم الإيرادات دون تحول حقيقي في الطلب على الذكاء الاصطناعي.

stories.title: OpenAI employee and Saudi suspect ‘came to the US with a dream’, lawyer says
stories.summary: Saudi OpenAI employee Abdulrahman Alfozan, arrested on 9 Oct over a hidden recording device, had booked one-way tickets to Saudi Arabia per an 8 Oct prosecutors' motion; his lawyer says the charge is a recording-statute case, with a detention hearing on 19 Oct.
bullets: Abdulrahman Alfozan, a Saudi citizen and OpenAI employee, was arrested on October 9 over a recording device allegedly hidden behind a TV in a San Francisco conference room
An October 8 prosecutors' motion said he, his wife and a third family member had booked one-way tickets from San Francisco to Saudi Arabia (via Istanbul)
Lawyer William Pernik says the charge is under a federal recording statute, not trade-secret theft; a detention hearing is set for October 19
stories.lenovo: Rising US scrutiny of Saudi links to frontier AI; expect tighter export-control diligence on US-origin GPUs for KSA deals. Keep end-user documentation ready.
stories.arabic: أفاد الادعاء الأمريكي بأن مهندس OpenAI الموقوف عبدالرحمن الفوزان حجز تذاكر ذهاب فقط إلى السعودية له ولعائلته، فيما وصف محاميه الاتهامات بأنها لا تشبهه.

stories.title: Shares of Oracle, neoclouds drop on CoreWeave debt concerns
stories.published: 15 Oct 2026, 01:20 KSA (Bloomberg first at 21:29 KSA on 14 Oct)
stories.summary: CoreWeave fell more than 15.5% as one bond's yield briefly passed 15%; Oracle fell 8.8% and DigitalOcean, TeraWulf and Hut 8 more than 10% each.
bullets: CoreWeave stock plummeted more than 15.5%; it reportedly has $50 billion in outstanding obligations
A $1.25 billion batch of CoreWeave bonds briefly saw its yield pass 15%
Oracle closed 8.8% lower; DigitalOcean, TeraWulf and Hut 8 each fell more than 10%
stories.lenovo: GPU-cloud credit stress supports owned or consumption-based on-premises AI for META enterprises and flags counterparty risk on Gulf neocloud-style projects.
stories.arabic: تراجعت أسهم أوراكل وشركات السحابة الناشئة بعد أن تحولت سندات CoreWeave إلى مستويات متعثرة وهبط سهمها أكثر من 15%، وسط قلق متزايد من تمويل البنية التحتية للذكاء الاصطناعي.

stories.title: Global Smartphone Shipments Drop Record High of 22% in Q3 2026 as the Memory Crisis Hits Hard, According to IDC
stories.summary: IDC's preliminary data show Q3 smartphone shipments fell 22.0% to 255.3M, the worst on record, with memory costs up about 350%; Xiaomi, OPPO and vivo fell about 30% while Samsung and Apple held up.
bullets: The global smartphone market shrank 22.0% year-on-year to 255.3 million units in 3Q26
Memory costs have surged approximately 350% since last year and are still rising
Samsung led with 57.8 million units (22.6% share), ahead of Apple at 57.3 million (22.4%)
stories.lenovo: The squeeze hits mid and low tier phones hardest, the core of the META and Africa market; for PCs, memory allocation is now the key competitive variable.
stories.arabic: أعلنت IDC تراجع شحنات الهواتف الذكية عالمياً 22% في الربع الثالث 2026 إلى 255.3 مليون جهاز، وهو أكبر انخفاض مسجل، بسبب ارتفاع تكلفة الذاكرة نحو 350% على أساس سنوي.

stories.title: TSMC Reports Third Quarter EPS of NT$29.43
stories.summary: TSMC posted record Q3 revenue of NT$1,494.24bn (+50.9%) and net income of NT$763.06bn (+68.7%), with a 66.4% gross margin, and guided Q4 revenue to US$52.3–54.3bn.
bullets: Q3 revenue of NT$1,494.24 billion and net income of NT$763.06 billion; revenue up 50.9% and net income up 68.7% year-over-year
Gross margin was 66.4%, operating margin 58.7%; 2-nanometer was 8% and 3-nanometer 33% of wafer revenue
Q4 revenue guided between US$52.3 billion and US$54.3 billion
stories.lenovo: Leading-edge AI silicon demand intact despite the sell-off; GPU and CPU supply stays tight for 2027, so allocation-backed delivery dates remain a META differentiator.
stories.arabic: أعلنت TSMC أرباحاً فصلية قياسية بلغت 763 مليار دولار تايواني بنمو 68.7% وإيرادات 46.72 مليار دولار، مع توقعات للربع الرابع بين 52.3 و54.3 مليار دولار.

stories.title: Seoul shares crash over 7% on chip rout amid AI, inflation woes
stories.summary: The Kospi closed down 7.57% at 5,554.22, with Samsung down 9.48% and SK hynix down 11.06%, on AI-spending doubts, memory competition and US inflation fears.
bullets: KOSPI fell 454.59 points, or 7.57 percent, to 5,554.22, its seventh straight losing session
Trading on the main bourse was halted for 20 minutes after the KOSPI fell more than 8 percent
Samsung Electronics fell 9.48 percent to 210,000 won and SK hynix dropped 11.06 percent to 1.26 million won
stories.lenovo: Equity rout is not price relief: spot and contract memory prices are still rising. Don't let customers delay META orders on a memory-peak narrative; keep indexation.
stories.arabic: هبط مؤشر كوسبي الكوري 7.57% مع تراجع سهمي سامسونج 9.48% وإس كيه هاينكس 11.06% وسط شكوك حول استدامة إنفاق الذكاء الاصطناعي ومخاوف التضخم.

stories.title: 32GB of DDR5 6000 RAM now costs $450 — AI-induced shortage reaches worst milestone yet
stories.summary: The cheapest 32GB DDR5-6000 kit now costs $449.97, up from $400 in August, and retail RAM prices are up more than 500% in a year.
bullets: The cheapest 32GB DDR5 6000 kit now costs $449.97, up from $400 in August
RAM prices have increased by more than 500% since last year
A Corsair 32GB DDR5 4800 kit that once cost $80 is now $399
stories.lenovo: Retail memory pricing shapes consumer PC price perception in GCC retail; pre-configured Legion and IdeaPad systems with secured allocation are a value story.
stories.arabic: ارتفع سعر أرخص طقم ذاكرة DDR5 سعة 32 جيجابايت إلى نحو 450 دولاراً، مع زيادة أسعار الذاكرة للمستهلكين بأكثر من 500% خلال عام بسبب نقص الإمدادات الناتج عن الذكاء الاصطناعي.

stories.title: SK Hynix reportedly ties US NAND fab plan to approval for chip equipment exports to China
stories.summary: SK hynix reportedly seeks US approval to ship more tools to its Dalian NAND plant, tied to a possible new US factory.
bullets: SK Hynix is seeking US approval to ship more American chipmaking equipment to its NAND flash plant in Dalian, China
The request is tied to a possible investment in a new US factory, per Reuters citing two people familiar with the matter
stories.lenovo: 2027 NAND supply for server and storage builds depends on US–Korea–China tool politics, adding risk premium to multi-year META storage quotes.
stories.arabic: أفادت تقارير بأن إس كيه هاينكس تربط خطة مصنع NAND في الولايات المتحدة بالحصول على موافقة أمريكية لتصدير معدات الرقائق إلى مصنعها في داليان بالصين.

stories.title: Samsung reportedly completes 4F² DRAM development as China's CXMT targets year-end launch
stories.summary: Samsung has reportedly completed 4F² DRAM development and will time commercialisation to customer needs, while CXMT targets 4F² server DDR5 by year-end.
bullets: Samsung Electronics has reportedly completed development of next-generation 4F² DRAM technology
Samsung is aligning commercialization with customer requirements, while China's CXMT prepares to introduce server memory
stories.lenovo: Medium-term supply signal, not near-term relief; expect Chinese DRAM qualification questions from cost-sensitive META buyers and set a clear compliance line for Gulf government deals.
stories.arabic: أفادت تقارير بأن سامسونج أنهت تطوير ذاكرة DRAM بتقنية 4F²، فيما تستهدف CXMT الصينية إطلاق وحدات DDR5 للخوادم بالتقنية نفسها بنهاية 2026.
